images.title: Target minus start
images.purpose: Show that the button to press is the target floor minus the starting floor: from Floor +2 to Floor +5 is +3.
images.composition: One vertical lift shaft centred with a single upward arrow beside it, lots of white space.
images.exact_structure: One vertical shaft with 6 equal floor lines, evenly spaced, labelled 0 to +5 bottom to top. A teal #0072B2 dot at floor +2 (start) and an amber #E69F00 dot at floor +5 (target). One reddish purple #CC79A7 upward arrow from the teal dot to the amber dot spanning exactly 3 floors. Exactly 6 floor lines, 2 dots, 1 arrow.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
an arrow that does not span exactly 3 floors, or an arrow pointing down
images.takeaway: Target floor minus starting floor gives the button.
images.description: A lift shaft with a start dot at +2 and a target dot at +5, an upward arrow of 3 floors labelled +3, and +5 − +2 = +3 below.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to count the floors the arrow climbs and say which floor is the target.

image_decisions.why: The idea is a picture idea; one clean image carries it.
